displayName: Allow hyperlinks in suspected phishing e-mail messages (User)
description:
This policy setting controls whether hyperlinks in suspected phishing e-mail messages in Outlook are allowed. 

If you enable this policy setting, Outlook will allow hyperlinks in suspected phishing messages that are not also classified as junk e-mail. 

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, Outlook will not allow hyperlinks in suspected phishing messages, even if they are not classified as junk e-mail.
